text: If you have not taken my courses and do not understand what some “sixth chakra” has to do with it, I recommend that you combine taking this intensive with a workshop or course in which I smoothly lead to an understanding of what we are doing here. It is important not simply to “believe” me, but to discover understanding within yourself through personal experience—both on the yoga mat and in life. Then the practices begin to work much more deeply. Otherwise we get physical education—since this is the basic understanding (experience) of yoga that everyone has.
